batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c A Ashish Reddy b I Sharma

batting.name: AM Nayar
batting.dismissal: c BB Samantray b NLTC Perera

balls.text: fullish ball from Dinda and smashed down the ground by Steyn for a four! Suddenly they have got themselves to 119!

gone, Mishra's run-out! goes down the track this time, Mishra was looking to get it through extra-cover but he does not get it off the middle of the bat, the fielder comes in well and gets the throw back into Uthappa's gloves, who whips 'em away with Mishra just short!
another slower one and the batsman waits on it before cracking it through the covers for a couple of runs
slower one and down the leg side, wide added to the total
what a shot! the mid-off was up inside the circle and Mishra opened himself up, gets the ball full and drills it through wide mid-off for a four!
again a very full ball, is able to get it away to long-on where Smith fields
yorker, tailing into the batsman and Mishra is able to get his bat down in time, driven to long-on for a single
okay so it's catching on now, the reverse flick, this is Mishra trying it now but does not get too much power on it and rolls over to short third-man for a single
very full yet again and the smashing straight drive goes to the fielder this time, fielded too
shot sir! it's fuller on the middle stump and it's got the pace that the batsman needs to get it over the fielder, he does just that, smashes it over the long-on fielder for a maximum
yorker length ball but Mishra does well to dig it out and gets a single to long-on
full-toss from Mathews and it's smacked down the ground, but only for a single
fuller which is taken on the full by the batsman, smashes it straight back but Mathews does not get anything on it and Manish Pandey fumbles at long-off
slower one with a lot of width, tries to smash it over the the covers, the outside edge does not carry through to the keeper
shorter from Dinda and Mishra takes full toll of it, remains very still and opens the face of the bat, goes to the right of the keeper, very fine and for a four
fullish and quickish too, drilled it to short cover where Mathews gets a hand to it, ricochets it to long-off for a single
a very slower one, he was looking to move away outside the off stump and scoop it over fine-leg but the ball just didn't arrive
fuller, quicker and tries to loft it over, goes on a couple of bounces to a very straight long-on for a single
full-toss and he wanted to crack it away through the covers, gets it to the fielder, Mathews, and he underarms it to the non-striking end, misses, had he hit there, it would have been curtains!
and now on the leg side, taps it away for the fifth single of the over, not too bad given the situation of the game
outside the off and fuller again, driven to the deep cover region for a single
driven down the ground for a single again, good stuff from the lower order
fuller, slower and yorks the batsman, he's able to get the bat down in time and defends it well.
fuller from Mathews and drilled down the ground for a single
length on the middle stump and he gently opens the face of the bat, pushes it to the off side for a single
punches it through the covers for a single to round off the 16th over which brings us to the Time-out.
fuller on the middle and driven to long-on for a single
shortish in length, the bat face was opened and he gets it to the third-man region for a single could have been a second there but not taken
fuller on the middle and he tries to smoke it over mid-wicket, does not get too much bat on it, drilled to long-on for a run
short of length, outside the off and slower one, Mishra had a lot of time to cut it away but the bat does not touch the ball
down the leg side and he does not get any bat on it, called wide
fullish on his pads and driven to long-on for a single

hits in the air and is caught at long-off! Sunny G on TV commentary calls it a soft dismissal and I have no reason to disagree, he was doing well so far but this is a fuller one and he tries to chip it over the in-field. Unfortunately it ends up being a tame shot that goes to the long-off fielder
shorter this time as the batsman tries to give himself room, drives it through short cover and is able to come back for the second
cracks it to the short cover region, but straight to the fielder
goes down the track and wants to hit it away but the bowler shortens the length, driven to long-off
shorter this time and despite the turn, he's able to control that cut shot of his, gets it away to the sweeper region
beaten, almost outside edge! little turn away from the bat and wanted to drive at it, missed
slower one but it's well played by the batsman, sees it through to his bat, opens the face and guides it away for a single
shorter in length, does not come on to the bat too quickly and the leading edge falls in the cover region, single for the batsman
outside the off stump and he opens the face of the bat, guides it to third-man for a single
length ball defended to mid-on and they don't add to their runs

appeal for a run-out but the batsman's well in. It was driven through the covers and by the time the sweeper fielder came across to get to the ball and throw it back to Uthappa, the batsmen had crossed over for a couple, did not even need the third ump
short of length, outside the off stump and swinging away from the bat, tries to glide it to third-man but does not get any bat on it
aah, crisp straight drive, misses Mathews right hand but only for a single, as the long-off fielder tidies up
slower ball again, it was on his pads too and Mishra it able to flick it away to fine-leg for a single
fuller on the middle and driven to extra-cover and not for runs
slower on the middle stump and pushed to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, swinging away as well and a mis-hit gets him a single
fuller on the leg-stump, cramping him for some room and it's only tapped to the leg side
quicker one to finish, skids into the batsman, defended back to the bowler
bad ball, full-toss and finally a six! Who would have thought! was trying a wrong 'un and dispatched over square-leg to get to 28
fuller on the leg stump and flicked away to the square-leg region for a single
defended on the front foot, to the off side for a single
cuts away and to the fence! it was a shorter one from Rahul but this time he gets over the bounce and adds four to his score, was in the air for some time
scooped over the wicket-keeper but for a single alone, he clears his foot and gets it out to the off stump to get that shot going, not too much pace in it though
single to end the over, driven to long-on, was a fuller one from Marsh
poor delivery, on his pads and Mishra helps himself to a free boundary, flicked away very gently to the fence

edged and taken, Perera's gone now! Very poor shot under the circumstances, it was wider outside the off and Perera went for a blazing cover drive, like Sanath Jayasuriya in his prime would, unfortunately for him it only gets an outside edge and Uthappa takes a good catch.
driven to long-on, was a fuller one and easily tapped away for a single
on his pads and run-out missed! it was flicked to the short fine-leg fielder and the batsman was off for a suicidal run, he was halfway down and the throw misses the stumps
in the air as he looks to drive it on the up, gets an outside edge and flies to third-man for a single
short of length and wanted to cut it away, misses
fullish on the off stump and he tries to push it to the off side, gets an inside edge on to the pads
driven down to long-off for a single
fuller on the off stump and he was looking to drive it, almost gets himself yorked

gone, lbw, given! that was a strange appeal, it hits the pads and only the bowler was going for it, went on and on, went once, paused, went twice and would have appealed the third time had the umpire not raised his finger. On the other hand, Uthappa did not even look, he was more interested in where the ball was! Replays suggest it was close enough to be given out.
fuller on the off stump and a bit of turn back, defended to the off side, wanted a single but the non-striker sends him back
quicker, shorter, on the pads and flicked to backward square-leg region for a single
another slowish off break and he taps it to the off side, not for runs
slower ball on his pads and flicked away to the leg side for a single
half-edge, half opens the face of the bat and guides it through third-man for a four! The third-man was kept square on this slow pitch but Marsh's pace gets the ball very fine
a very slow, slower ball, waits for it, opens the face of the bat and it trickles down to the third-man for a single
fuller on the middle stump and it's flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single
fullish outside the off and easily knocked down to long-off to get them a single
wants to lash at it but the slowness of the track defeats the shot, drives it to long-on for a single
fuller and slower from Rahul and should have been driven through the covers, instead it's tapped to short cover
on the back foot and punched down the ground to long-on for a single
fuller this time, quicker too and defended on the front foot to the off side
shorter but some bounce and the flick goes to short square-leg
short of length and opens the face of the bat to the off side, not for runs though and that's the end of his spell, one of the very good ones from a good swing bowler
defended on the back foot and to the right of the bowler, who has to rush across to get close to it and in the mean time they get a single
opens the face of the bat, despite the presence of two slips and it runs down to third-man for a single
bouncer and called a wide! tries to change things around there and digs it very short but it goes well over the batsman and rightly called a wide
defended on the off side and to the fielder
appeal for an lbw, the ball was pitching on middle and hitting the pads first, but not given. Looked close to me!
short of good length and it hits the bat hard as the batsman tries to defend at it, the ball flies through the off side for a couple of runs
guides it to the off side where Finch flies across and fields well at gully
slows it down, on the middle stump and he gently taps it to square-leg to get across for a single
aah, a full-bloodied pull over the mid-wicket for a four! it was short of length again and he was looking to play his shot there, good thing too given the situation
short of length and pulled away to the right of mid-on for a couple of runs
edged and on the bounce to the keeper. it was not too quick either and the batsman was looking to open the face of the bat.
short of length, slower on the middle stump and tapped straight back in front of him, wanted a single but is sent back

edged and taken! BK's got his third! he was bowling them outside the off but this one was a lot closer and to go with the swing away from the bat, it made it a potent delivery. Looking to defend at it, takes the outside edge and flies to the first slip where after a bit of a juggle, it's caught.
and again, change of length but impeccable line outside the off, the batsman's happy too, to leave it alone definitely a lot of swing for BK
shorter in length, outside the off, wants the batsman to go after him but he lets it go through
and now on the back-foot, defended to to the off side yet again
fuller on the off stump and the batsman defends on the front foot, rolls over to the off side where there is a bunch of fielders waiting
down the leg side, misses his line and despite no swing on that one, it's wide enough to be called a wide.
hat-trick avoided, fuller and swinging back in but pushed it to mid-on
and now on a good length, the previous bouncers seemed to have softened him up a little and he was looking to defend a tad warily, misses the outside edge
bouncer again, and down the leg side, he ducks under the bouncer
outside the off on a length and he has a swish at it, misses and it goes through to the keeper
short of length, digging it in and though it does not rise too much, the batsman goes under it, it was a touch wide too
and now a bit of bounce for Dinda, was playing on the back foot and taps it to third-man for a single
outside the off stump and left alone by the new number three, too wide to go fiddling at it given the score

bowled him again! White's now out and BK's on a hat-trick! It was an in-swinger that kept a tad low too, White was playing neither forward nor back and the ball sneaks through him, the stumps are rattled and they are three down

got him! bowled! he was looking to defend at it, and it looked like he was waiting for it to swing back, it did but not as much as he thought and plays inside the line, misses, bowled. Checking for a no-ball but it's clearly not.
again that opening of the face of the bat and this time in much more control. Who was not in control was the fielder at third-man, Nayar and the misfield allows them to come back for the second
down the leg-side and it goes for four more, seems to have taken some bat of the Parthiv bat and it races away, beats Uthappa behind and for the second four this over
pushed to the off side and wanted a single, sent back by the non-striker
edged and goes through the slips for a four! He was looking to open the face of the bat but the ball seems to have bounced more than he thought it would and it flies off the edge...not to hand
gone, caught! was looking to get inside the line of the ball and smack it through the covers but gets it in air and straight to the fielder there, Hyderabad have lost their first!
down the leg side and given wide, was looking to scoop it over the fine-leg by moving to the off side, doesn't get any bat.
no change in the length and de Kock wants to go down, give himself some room and crack it through the covers, but gets it away to the point fielder
short of length again and on his pads, flicked away to the square-leg and rotates the strike again
short of length again and de Kock has a bit of difficulty playing it away, pushes it to the leg side for a single
goes down the track and the ball does not come on to the bat, he was looking to pull it over mid-wicket, instead it flies to mid-on but on bounce
short of length on the middle stump and defended away to the leg side

big, big appeal for an lbw, that was jagging back into the batsman and Patel got nowhere close to it. Well, at least his bat did not, hits the pads and the appeal followed, could have gone over the stumps.
bit of swing back into the batsman and defended on the back-foot, taps it to the leg side for a single
fuller from Bhuvneshwar this time and he has no hesitation in going for a drive, straight to the cover fielder though
very outside the off but not wide enough to be called a wide. de Kock shoulders arms and it goes through
swing for Bhuvneshwar Kumar, opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single to get away today
on a length and swing away from the left-hander, lets that one go through to the keeper
hat-trick! Mishra gets three in three and Pune have been rolled over! this was a good ball, a googly, it came into the batsman and beats the defensive stroke from Dinda, rattles the stumps.

and gone, bowled! they are swinging hard but barely connecting, you cannot do this! it was fuller and Rahul wanted to slog it over mid-wicket for a six, not a tap away for a single but wanted to smash a six, clean bowls him.

and given out lbw now! Its Rauf again! that's an excellent delivery, fuller, googly, beats the inside edge of the bat and hits the batsman's pads, there's another loud, long appeal and Rauf thinks like he's attempting a tough mathematics puzzle before giving it out.
fullish from Mishra and driven down the ground to long-on for a single

goes for a biggie and goes back to the pavillion! whatever's happening at Pune? It was flighted from Mishra, Mathews, the captain, tries to smoke it over long-off and what he does instead is gets an outside edge, goes straight to the fielder in the deep!
driven through the covers for a single to the sweeper fielder
slower from Perera and pushed into the covers for a single
the length does not change and the batsman is able to push it into the covers, not for runs though
this is way better shot from Pandey, it was short too but the batsman was going back to play it, whacks it over mid-wicket for a four
they continue to pepper them with the short balls and the batsman has no option but to defend it on the back foot

another short one gets another wicket! another poor shot, another wicket, and he's gone caught at mid-on. Short of length, came on quickly on to the batsman who fails to keep it down, easily lobs up for the fielder
shortish ball and it jags back into the batsman too, who defends it off the back foot, not for a run

top-edged and caught! that was nearly a 149 km/hr delivery and Marsh was looking to take Steyn on, gets high on the bat and the hurried pull lands straight into the hands of the deep square-leg fielder, poor shot with the victory in sight.
shortish again and at some pace from Steyn but Marsh does well to push it to the off side
shorter again and easily pulled away to the leg side for a single
length ball from Steyn and Mathews was looking to play a very strange-looking stroke, wanted to flick it away but it's outside the off, and he misses
bouncer that does not rise as high as Steyn would have liked, manages to pull it to fine-leg for a single
short of length and wow, that's been pulled, scratch that, smacked by Marsh through the wide mid-on region for a four!
punched down the ground to long-on for a single
and follows it up with a defensive stroke to the off side
finally a six! this was needed for Pune and it's Marsh who goes down the ground and hits a very flat six over long-off
was giving himself a lot of room, was looking to cut it, but beats the outside edge
and this time he goes down the ground and drives it to long-on for a single
flighted slightly, slower too and Mathews is content in defending it back
turned away to the leg side for a single for the captain
and the slog sweep, over mid-wicket for a four, almost goes to the fielder, who had to dive to his left, was some distance away
and another one! this was slightly shorter and Mathews wanted to cut it hard, misses the outside edge
turn and bounce and beats Mathews outside the off! well bowled!
fuller from Sharma and driven down the ground for a single
pitched on the leg side, taps it away to the short fine-leg for a single

another one! and this time there's an appeal for a stumping too! pitching on the off stump and was looking to defend at it, beaten outside the off stump and Parthiv is quick to whip off the bails, he was in though.
whoa, that's the delivery of the match! it's landed on the middle and leg stump and beaten the outside edge!
fuller and easily driven down the ground for a single
the googly, but slightly shorter and he was able to adjust quickly, pushed to the leg side for a single
fuller on the leg stump, pushed away to the leg side for a single
slower from Mishra, defended back to the bowler
outside the off stump with the short of length and pushed to the covers for a dot.
Ishants continuing to bowl that favourite length of his and this time Mathews nudges it away to the leg side for a single
short of length outside the off and Mathews is able to defend it of the back foot to the off side
gone, pulled and caught! short of length, it's been pulled but the top-edge goes high in the air, Ashish Reddy gets under it and takes a very well-judged catch, just inches away from the rope too!
the mid-off was up and he was looking to forehand it over that fielder, gets it off the bottom of the bat and still over the fielder, not too much power though
short of length and pushed to the off side by Mathews, gets a single to deep cover
pushed to the off side and straight to the fielder, only two off it
slows it up, shortens the length and Smith has to check his advancing stroke, defended
fuller, straighter, wanted to sweep but does not get too much bat on it
wants to drill it through the covers but goes to de Kock on the bounce
and now Mathews repeats the does, shimmy down the pitch and pushed to long-off
fuller from the leggie and Smith is immediately down the track, pushing it down to long-off for a single
shorter in length and on his pads, tapped to the leg side for a single
short of length but this one keeps a tad low, one of the vagaries of the pitch, beats the outside edge of the bat, for the first time Smith looks a bit under-cooked
short of length and on the middle stump, Smith was looking to pull it away but he misses it
yep, on his pads yet again, easily tapped away to fine-leg for a single
this is shorter in length and easily pulled away to the same region and for the same result, drifting too much on the leg side I think
fuller on his pads and flicked away to mid-wicket for a couple of runs
outside the off stump, short of length and punched to the point fielder, not for runs but they have already got six runs in the over
good length this time but Smith loves to hang back and pull it to backward square-leg for a couple
shorter in length but easily pulled away, it was more of a help-it-on-its-way stroke to deep square-leg for a couple
short of length, punched to the covers and for a single to get Smith back on strike
short of length and pushed to the short cover, straight to captain Cameron who has a shy at the non-strikers end, misses
short of length and Smith looked like he was expecting that, pushes it to the leg side for a quick single
fuller from Sharma, he was going down the pitch and flicks it to the leg side for a single
fuller, flighted too and driven down the ground for a single
quicker one and he was on his back foot, suddenly sprung up on him, but defended well

wow, given! lbw! again, seemed like a very strange one, only the bowler was really interested and Asad Rauf thought hard and thought long before giving it out! It was a googly and beats the inside edge of the bat.
quicker on his pads, bit of turn, flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
shortish from the bowler and easily pushed down to long-on for a single
six singles in the over, fuller from Mishra for a change and he's able to drive it down the ground for a single
again, not really up to the bat and is easily able to tap it down the ground for a single
very short, very slow and easily worked it down the ground for a single
taps it away to the leg side for a single
slower, shorter and he was on his back foot, pushes it down back to the bowler who is restricted - unintentionally - by the non-striker and they are able to get a single
goes down the track and pushes it through the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, lets it go through to the wicket-keeper
a very short bouncer, he was looking to pull it away but gets only a glove, runs away over the keeper for a four
and now wants to go down the track, smack it over the in-field but the inside edge gets him a single
was looking to defend it on the front foot before opening the face of the bat, runs it down to third-man for a single, it was a length ball too
shorter in length and this time he punches it to the off side, straight to the fielder
fuller from Perera and flicked away to the leg side for a couple of quickly taken runs
continues bowling that length and tapped to to the off side
outside edge, not too dissimilar from the Finch dismissal but it goes a tad finer and to third-man for a single
another one, short of length and very awkwardly defended by Suman, just about keeps it out, tapped to the off side
shorter from Ishant but does not rise up too much, Suman defends off the back foot and it rolls over to the off side
outside the off and lets it go through to the keeper does Suman
pushed to mid-on and they are away for a very quickly taken single
slower one, opens the face of the bat and runs it through to the third-man region for a single
short of length and Smith pushes it to the covers
outside the off, was an effort ball too and swings away from the batsman, lets it go through to the keeper
gone, two in two! Perera has a second! this was short of length and the bounce beats the back-foot punch from Finch, he gets it off the bat alright but it's in air and straight to the point fielder!

gone now, caught at deep square-leg! it was on his pads and Uthappa was looking to flick it away, the ball flew off it and is easily lapped up by the fielder there, the batsman's not happy about something there.
short of length and defended back to the bowler, off the back foot
and again on his pads, Steyn's having a bad spell (of two overs here), he's been flicked away to the backward square-leg region for a couple of runs
fuller and driven, but straight to the mid-off fielder

outside edge, in fact a leading outside edge that carries it to the fence for a four! It was on the middle and Finch was looking to flick it away to the leg side, gets the edge and runs over the covers for a four
short of length and on the off stump, Finch gets to defend it to the off side
on his pads this time and beaten for pace. bit of an appeal for lbw but it looked like it was going down the leg-side
outside the off and Finch has hit it on the up and through the covers for a four! That barely looked like it was hit and it's easily gone all the way.
and now defended on the move forward, well done Robin
wow, driven, down the ground, with disdain! He gets very close to the pitch of the ball and swings his bat through the line of the ball, gets it down the ground for a four!
another one that's shorter in length and Finch's quickly on to his back foot and punches it to the off side, they cross over for a quick one
shot, finally Finch's able to get it away. Ishant's bowling a tad short here, and the batsman's able to get it away through the point region for a four
short of length and it keeps low, wanted to crack it through the covers but misses the under-edge

ooh, almost! it was pushed to the off side and they wanted to go for a single, both of them, but the striker immediately said no and Uthappa was almost halfway down the pitch, the throw doesn't hit the stumps again!
on the off stump and pushed to the covers, finally a dot again from Steyn, 12 off that over
ouch, almost a wicket via run-out! pushed to the off side and they were off for a single, but Finch was struggling to make it there, a direct hit would have got him out.
poor start this from Steyn, it's fuller on the legs of Uthappa and deftly pushed away to the deep square-leg region for a couple
but he follows it up with another one on his pads and Uthappa is very still, just a gentle push over the mid-wicket region again, for a four too!
beaten! The first one swung too but it was off line, this one, perfect! around the off stump, leaving the bat and beats him. No edge though.
on his pads and easily flicked away by Uthappa, hit over the in-field on the leg side and beats the field, four to Uthappa
short of length but wow that one actually swung away from Ishant, beats the outside edge
shorter in length but not too much bounce to test the batsman, pushes it into the cover region for a single

and this time it's on the other side, misses his line and Uthappa goes for a scoop-flick, Ashish Reddy runs around and almost makes a mess of it, but a good diving effort in the end restricts it to two
edged and four! it was fuller outside the off and Uthappa went tonking at it, gets an outside edge and that flies off it, over the lone slipper in place
pitches up only slightly and Uthappa gets it nicely in the middle of the bat, defended to the off side
outside the off, short of length and Uthappa has a waft at it, misses the outside edge, SRH need a lot of those to get the edge
